description: This file defines the MonkeyNoopEvent class, a subclass of MonkeyEvent, representing a no-operation event for the Android monkey testing tool. The class provides an injectEvent method that performs no actions, serving as a placeholder or synchronization point during testing.

classes.name: MonkeyNoopEvent
classes.description: Represents a no-operation event within the Android monkey testing framework, overriding injectEvent to perform no action.

methods.name: MonkeyNoopEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing the event type to NOOP.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Performs no operation; logs 'NOOP' if verbose > 1 and returns success status.
